ambiguity.detail: Clarissa is revealed to be Juliana's sister, making the betrayal much deeper.

verdict.cliffhanger_line: Long enough to know he was never going to marry you.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A jilted bride discovers her groom has cruelly replaced her at the altar with her own sister in a premeditated conspiracy.
verdict.why_it_works: Immediate emotional devastation combined with an evil sister trope guarantees high retention and anger-driven watch time.
